tools.name: pivot_bake_pivot
tools.description: Origin to Pivot: Move object origin to the pivot AND align local axes to the pivot orientation, keeping the mesh in place. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: pivot_reset_pivot
tools.description: Reset Pivot: Reset pivot: 3D Cursor back to world origin (identity orientation), Median Point pivot, Global orientation. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: pivot_to_active
tools.description: Pivot to Active Object: Snap pivot to the active object's origin and orientation. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.
